content_voiceover: This slide maps out AML maintenance therapy options for patients who achieve complete remission after intensive chemotherapy but do not go on to allogeneic transplant. Right now, only Onureg, which is oral azacitidine, is FDA approved in this setting, based on overall survival benefit shown in the QUAZAR trial published in the New England Journal in 2020. Other HMA-based maintenance strategies have been studied, injectable azacitidine and decitabine showed disease free survival benefit, and azacitidine plus venetoclax and Onureg plus venetoclax, that's the VIALE-M trial, are being explored. For FLT3 mutated patients specifically, FLT3 inhibitor maintenance is an option, midostaurin for one year based on the 2017 New England Journal data, or quizartinib for up to three years based on the 2023 Lancet QuANTUM-First data we just covered. Now, an important caveat about QUAZAR, 68 percent of enrolled patients had received no consolidation or only one cycle before starting Onureg, and patients who did receive consolidation actually had a statistically inferior reduction in hazards of death compared to those with no consolidation at all. Also, the optimal duration of maintenance was never defined in that trial.
keypoints: Onureg (oral azacitidine) is the only FDA-approved maintenance option, non-HSCT setting
Alternative HMA options: azacitidine, decitabine, azacitidine plus venetoclax
FLT3-mutated patients can receive midostaurin (1 year) or quizartinib (3 years) maintenance
QUAZAR caveat: most patients had minimal consolidation, and duration was undefined
keypoint_voiceover: Key takeaway, in patients who don't proceed to transplant, Onureg is the only FDA-approved maintenance drug, proven in the QUAZAR trial. If the patient is FLT3 mutated, FLT3 inhibitor maintenance, midostaurin or quizartinib, is an alternative pathway. But remember the QUAZAR caveat for boards, most patients in that trial had little to no consolidation therapy, which complicates how generalizable the survival benefit is, and the ideal maintenance duration remains unknown.
